title: Grateful Dead Live at Internationales Congress Centrum on 1990-10-20
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (WAV 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition CC 2022 > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/24
taper: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy

ai_review.summary: Excellent ultramatrix restoration with crisp Jerry vocals and freed Phil bass delivering a clean, shiny listening experience
ai_review.review: The Miller‑sourced ultramatrix has been meticulously cleaned up, giving the highs more shine and making Jerry’s vocals and Phil’s bass sound surprisingly clear and free from their usual low‑frequency muddiness. Reviewers rate it as the best listen yet for this show, indicating both a high‑quality recording and an enjoyable performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review praises the restored matrix source as outstanding; limited data on musical specifics keeps confidence low, but overall impression is highly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Restoration added shine to highs, reduced dust/scratch artifacts; Jerry's vocals and Phil's bass noted as crisp and freed from subterranean muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewer focuses on overall sound quality rather than individual songs.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals described as crisp and clearer after cleanup.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass noted as freed from low‑frequency muddiness, sounding more open.
